title: incl at subtotal, half-cent sum rounds DOWN in total_tax
woo_path: CT:677-685 line tax = round_line_tax(tax); line net = gross - UNROUNDED tax
WC:545 mode HALF_DOWN when prices incl tax
CT:872-875 items tax (units, unrounded) + NumberUtil::round(ship+fee tax, 2)
CART:579-582 set_total_tax -> wc_round_tax_total(v) at 2dp with tax mode
CT:871 grand total rounds the unrounded cents sum once, HALF_UP

ambiguous_detail.why: total_tax = wc_round_tax_total(1.665, 2) HALF_DOWN. Decimal 1.665 -> 1.66; the double 1.665 is 1.66500000000000003553 > tie, so a pure-binary round gives 1.67. PHP round() pre-rounding (<=8.3) and the edge-case check (8.4, RFC to change it was declined) both give 1.66.
